_readme: Authored by the kit: Presentation/RecordingClass.swift. The iOS Import footers and the
help topic 'What your recording can and cannot show' already read them from there; this
file carries the same strings to web/index.html and web/watches, which retyped them.
`footerLine` is `name + '. ' + line` — the shape a section footer wants. The web's
three-column table stays the web's own; only the cell contents are pinned.
Wholly kit-owned: COPY_WRITE=1 swift test --filter CopyContractTests rewrites it.

classes.footerLine: Everything. Foil time, flights, every turn verdict and clean jibe, measured speed records, the wind axis. Pump strokes and takeoff attempts too.
classes.line: Foil time, flights, every turn verdict and clean jibe, measured speed records, the wind axis. Pump strokes and takeoff attempts too.
classes.name: Everything

classes.footerLine: Measured speed. Everything except pump strokes and takeoff attempts, which need a wrist accelerometer nothing else records.
classes.line: Everything except pump strokes and takeoff attempts, which need a wrist accelerometer nothing else records.
classes.name: Measured speed

classes.footerLine: Measured speed and the wrist. Everything a file with measured speed gets, plus pump strokes and takeoff attempts. The watch app records the wrist at 50 Hz. The phone analyses it.

classes.footerLine: Positions only. Foil time, flights, every turn verdict and clean jibe, the wind axis. Speed records are estimated from positions and marked so, and there are no pump strokes or takeoff attempts.
